intro: Papua New Guinea is a parliamentary democracy with the British monarch as head of state.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The prime minister, James Marape since 2019, leads the government. Parliament has 118 members. Bougainville is an autonomous region.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: Tribal fighting in the highlands has caused deaths in recent years.

keyTerms.meaning: An area with its own government for some matters.
